name: Diffusion
author: Mark Steere (2006) / AGP port
description: Diffusion (Mark Steere, 2006): a Mancala with no capturing, no laps and no scoring. Scoop any one of the twelve pits and diffuse its stones one by one into the ring of pits AROUND it -- counterclockwise from the most clockwise neighbour, with each end-of-board store counting as two slots. A pit holds at most five stones; a sixth is banked in a store and leaves the game forever. The twelve pits are split into two blocks, and you win the instant YOUR OWN block is completely vacant -- no matter which player emptied it. Provably finite in at most 5944 plies, and draws really cannot occur.
